phase: P00 — Ground the actual project
title: Identify checkout and protect the baseline
work: Record actual checkout path, branch, full commit, dirty files and applicable repository instructions. Inventory existing Godot/Python entrypoints, tests, assets, fixtures and save formats. Preserve user edits. If the checkout is absent, request its path/repository and stop code work; do not guess a remembered remote.
checks: Evidence lists actual commands and files. Baseline commit is resolvable; user changes remain intact. Missing access is BLOCKED, never a fictional audit.

phase: P00 — Ground the actual project
title: Classify reuse and reconcile existing duel rules
work: Classify every existing world, economy, cart, faction, village, quest, dialogue, puzzle and duel entrypoint KEEP/ADAPT/REPLACE/RETIRE with its actual responsibility and callers. Identify competing truth owners. Capture actual Mastermind secrets, timing, feedback, defeat and save behaviour; choose compatible retention or C10 fallback with evidence.
checks: Every discovered active entrypoint has disposition and migration target. No competing quest engine is designated KEEP. Existing duel behaviour is recorded from files/tests, not memory.

phase: P00 — Ground the actual project
title: Pin tools and run existing checks
work: Record exact Python, Godot, test runner, export template and operating-system versions. Run existing meaningful tests and headless import where available. Record pre-existing failures separately. Check Windows packaging runner availability without requiring packaging now.
checks: Actual commands, exit codes and nonzero discovered test counts are retained. Missing Godot/runner is explicit. No passing status is assigned to unexecuted checks.

phase: P00 — Ground the actual project
title: Establish mapped layout and verification entrypoints
work: Map logical sim/dmb, client, content, tools and tests paths to the checkout. Implement or adapt the documented task/gate/scenario wrappers around existing test tools. A gate must fail if its required tests are missing or skipped. Keep the main runtime entrypoint unified.
checks: A deliberately failing test returns nonzero; an empty required suite returns nonzero; a known passing baseline is reported with commit/tool versions. Existing checks are still callable.

phase: P00 — Ground the actual project
title: Register implementation defaults and versioned manifests
work: Record C00 I01–I19 and source precedence, mapping all 34 GDD invariants to planned owners. Create development feature manifests for staged builds without claiming disabled features are complete. Preserve GDD and recipe source hashes.
checks: Manifest distinguishes prototype/MVP/full baseline; no permanent ten-recipe culture limit, runtime LLM or wizard HP is added. All source hashes match included originals.

phase: P00 — Ground the actual project
title: Create executable progress and failure receipts
work: Adopt the pack task/gate schema. A receipt stores actual files, contracts, commands, results, commit and next task. Resume chooses first unmet dependency and respects manual gate status. Add a bounded three-attempt failure record and no-test-skipping rule.
checks: A completed task lacking evidence is rejected. A required manual gate remains pending until Joe records PASS. Resume after a failed task selects that task, not the next feature.

phase: P01 — Authoritative core and persistent state
title: Implement typed identity and deterministic allocation
work: Implement validated ID types and saved monotonic IdAllocator.new(kind). Separate instance, definition, cause, command, effect and lease IDs. Add canonical wire integer/decimal-string handling.
checks: test_id_resume: creation after reload never repeats; test_foreign_world_id rejected; test_large_counter_roundtrip preserves values beyond JSON exact integer range.

phase: P01 — Authoritative core and persistent state
title: Implement immutable definitions and catalogue validation
work: Load typed definitions through DefinitionCatalog; validate kinds, references, quantities and enum spellings. Calculate canonical manifest hashes. Keep mutable instances outside definitions.
checks: Unknown reference, duplicate definition ID and negative cost fail clearly; ordering JSON keys leaves hash stable; changing a rate changes manifest hash.

phase: P01 — Authoritative core and persistent state
title: Implement WorldState registries and read views
work: Create the registry records in C01 and immutable scoped views. Add global reference/owner/status validation and tombstones. Empty registries are allowed in an early feature manifest, not silently substituted for required finished systems.
checks: Read-view mutation cannot modify state; dangling live reference fails; retired referenced person retains identity; definition and instance IDs cannot be interchanged.

phase: P01 — Authoritative core and persistent state
title: Implement gameplay RNG streams and replay inputs
work: Use a named versioned deterministic PRNG with exact saved states for board, dice, hazards, binding, policy and encounters. Replay records commands, clock advances, manifests and actual policy selections. Ambient visual RNG is separate.
checks: Same stream state resumes identical draws; adding an ambient animation changes no gameplay draw; differing dictionary insertion order produces the same ordered replay events.

phase: P01 — Authoritative core and persistent state
title: Implement transactions, commands and event receipts
work: Create WorldSim.dispatch, envelope validation, single-writer transactions and post-commit event batches. Receipt lookup precedes stale-version rejection; same ID with changed payload is ID_REUSE. No arbitrary patch command.
checks: Rejected command preserves state/RNG/next ID; duplicated successful command returns original result without mutation; injected handler error aborts all provisional writes.

phase: P01 — Authoritative core and persistent state
title: Implement clock tokens and fixed accounting boundaries
work: Implement integer Game Time/residual, unique clock sequences and scoped pause tokens. Support 100 ms world boundaries and 50 ms encounter alignment. No artificial time for Wait, no focus-loss catch-up.
checks: 60000 ms in varied chunks yields 600 quanta; two pause tokens require both releases; duplicate advance adds zero time; closed application duration adds no time.

phase: P01 — Authoritative core and persistent state
title: Implement turn roster and immediate outcome interrupts
work: Implement rotating captured roster, stage order and explicit era/terminal interrupts. Domain handlers not yet built are registered as unavailable, not fake-success operations. Add pure scripted stage tests with committed outcome events.
checks: A/B gets one seat each; removed B is skipped; an interrupt after a scoring action prevents subsequent stages; unfinished round produces no draft.

phase: P01 — Authoritative core and persistent state
title: Implement versioned save repository and migration boundary
work: Serialize every current authoritative registry, RNG, receipts and clock residual. Validate candidate load before swapping state; atomic replace with previous-good backup. Reject prototype saves without deleting them. Leave encounter snapshot field explicitly versioned for later bridge task.
checks: Save/load continuation has identical canonical state; corrupt candidate never replaces good slot/backup; unsupported source save remains untouched; IDs and RNG resume exactly.

phase: P02 — Bridge and first playable shell
title: Implement framed message codecs
work: Implement 4-byte big-endian length framing, UTF-8 JSON buffering, bounded payloads and schema errors on both sides. Do not assume read equals message.
checks: Shared fixtures cover split header, split multibyte text, two frames per read, malformed JSON and oversize frame. Both codecs decode the same valid envelopes.

phase: P02 — Bridge and first playable shell
title: Implement loopback server and authenticated handshake
work: Bind 127.0.0.1 with per-launch token, protocol/content checks and one writer queue. Expose handshake, read views and existing core commands. Keep token out of logs and save payload.
checks: Wrong token/version rejects; one accepted command increments version once; server binds no public interface; lost acknowledgement retry returns the prior receipt.

phase: P02 — Bridge and first playable shell
title: Implement sidecar launcher and WorldClient
work: Launch actual mapped Python entrypoint for development; resolve paths safely without shell interpolation. Capture endpoint, handshake, command queue, timeout and orderly child shutdown. Package-relative executable branch can be completed at release.
checks: Godot smoke launches sidecar, gets a view and quits with no orphan process. Paths containing spaces work. Startup failure produces a visible paused error.

phase: P02 — Bridge and first playable shell
title: Implement lease registry and checkpoint validation
work: Implement PREPARED/ACTIVE/FREEZING/CLOSED states, entity exclusivity, checkpoint sequence/hash/version and transfer handshake. Use a minimal real counter mechanism fixture to test ownership, not a second battle engine.
checks: Two active leases cannot own one entity; stale/duplicate delta cannot overwrite state; close returns authority once; failed preparation leaves original owner intact.

phase: P02 — Bridge and first playable shell
title: Coordinate saves and bounded bridge recovery
work: Add shared pause/freeze barrier, checkpoint persistence, reconnect from last coordinated save and bounded restart. Save actual rollback time. Do not reapply unacknowledged input speculatively.
checks: Terminate sidecar before/after acknowledgement and save barrier: restore a consistent pair of states with no added time/effects. A stale client cannot resume an old lease.

phase: P02 — Bridge and first playable shell
title: Build pointer-driven local movement and exits
work: Create a minimal local area using authoritative fixture IDs. Move with one pointer, observe outside range, interact inside range and expose adjacent Travel/Wait controls. Strategic exit waits for acknowledgement; held press sends one Wait.
checks: Headless/scripted scene checks one accepted exit command and no speculative destination mutation. Manual input route includes every basic action without right-click or keyboard.

phase: P02 — Bridge and first playable shell
title: Implement semantic views and hidden-information filtering
work: Introduce KnowledgeFact and SemanticResolver over real fixture entities. Use view tokens for current visibility/range; unknown identity stays selectable. Developer views are separately scoped.
checks: Unknown person label omits name; observation can reveal a permitted role; remote/invisible magic target token cannot be minted; debug-only fields never reach player projection.

phase: P02 — Bridge and first playable shell
title: Wire UI pause, focus and clock scheduling
work: Connect focus, formal choice and menu pause tokens to Game Time; retain ambient movement while unpaused. Implement fixed step accumulator and bounded pending mutation queue. Do not award backlog after focus return.
checks: Open two screens then close one: still paused. Sixty-second focus loss advances zero time. Different render frame patterns report identical accounting advances.

phase: P02 — Bridge and first playable shell
title: Create the normal-runtime fixture loader and launch panel
work: Load fixture initial state through the same schema/WorldSim and client projection. Expose seed, manifest, reset and replay output. Mark developer setup commands in traces. No alternate village/quest runtime.
checks: FX-CLOCK loads through production entrypoint, records inputs and reproduces its state. Invalid fixture references fail before play. Release mode hides developer setup controls.

phase: P02 — Bridge and first playable shell
title: Prepare the first playable bridge checkpoint
work: Run end-to-end startup/movement/Wait/pause/save/recovery smoke and prepare G01 playable instructions/seed/build. Include actual code revision and failures. Stop at G01 for Joe after automated checks.
checks: FX-CLOCK assertions pass across Python and Godot; no unexecuted check is labelled passed. G01 remains AWAITING_HUMAN and T025 is blocked until Joe accepts.

phase: P03 — Board, construction and physical cargo
title: Build exact hex-node-edge topology
work: Implement integer shared corners, 19 axial hexes, canonical node/edge IDs and reciprocal graph queries. Board stores geography, not political ownership.
checks: Radius-2 board has 19 hexes, 54 nodes, 72 edges; node degree/touching-hex limits hold; shortest paths and reciprocal adjacency agree.

phase: P03 — Board, construction and physical cargo
title: Generate validated faction starts and immutable geography
work: Seed terrain/number assignment and two sites per faction with distance checks, diversity/viability constraints and bounded deterministic fallback. Support 2/6 factions in the same setup code.
checks: Counts match source multiset; 2- and 6-faction fixture placements are legal; regeneration uses bounded attempts; same seed preserves topology/tokens/placements.

phase: P03 — Board, construction and physical cargo
title: Define baseline settlement, building and unit records
work: Create centre, warehouse, primary, processor and three factory-slot definitions/instances with health, footprint, job reference and upgrades. Add six MVP unit definitions for later manufacture. No subclass per recipe.
checks: Duplicate slots fail; city does not double primary count; missing definition/upgrade mapping fails; damaged/destroyed building has explicit capacity state.

phase: P03 — Board, construction and physical cargo
title: Implement persistent people and job identity foundation
work: Create people and one worker/anchor per production job with stable identity and basic role/preferences. Add vacancy, displacement and backfill APIs; deeper dialogue comes later.
checks: Changing workplace preserves original ID; backfill creates different ID; one person cannot hold conflicting active jobs; building destruction does not automatically kill its worker.

phase: P03 — Board, construction and physical cargo
title: Implement Catan roll grants and source suppression queries
work: Credit matching terrain goods only, 1 settlement/2 city, no desert/7 grants. Add pure queries over typed cube state for Catan/industrial/civilian blocking; propagation comes later.
checks: Every terrain/token case tested; industrial depletion does not stop Catan ore; one cube does; missing warehouse never invents a hidden spendable stockpile.

phase: P03 — Board, construction and physical cargo
title: Implement conserved stores and reservations
work: Create spendable/reserved/escrow classifications and atomic reserve/release/consume/loss. Store at real node IDs, including non-owning construction caches.
checks: Five timber→reserve 3 yields available 2/reserved 3; second reservation cannot overspend; cancellation restores same-node stock; ledger equation balances after recorded destruction.

phase: P03 — Board, construction and physical cargo
title: Implement legal placement and derived VP
work: Validate road extension, distance rule, own-road endpoint, city/current-era and legacy upgrade. Derive 1/2/0 scores from owned active centres; no separate VP source.
checks: Adjacent hostile/friendly/legacy centre blocks settlement equally; inert ruins do not; road cannot extend through hostile node; city is 2 total; no piece-cap rule added.

phase: P03 — Board, construction and physical cargo
title: Implement delivered construction orders and completion
work: Implement quotes, reservations, delivered status, revalidation and once-only completion with baseline facility grant. Check immediate 10-VP after each commit; return an interrupt to the orchestrator even before era conversion is implemented.
checks: Remote unshipped goods cannot pay; same completion ID cannot debit twice; illegal changed target retains/reclaims real goods; two candidate winners obey seat order.

phase: P03 — Board, construction and physical cargo
title: Implement persistent carts and load/unload transitions
work: Store cart identity/home/node/capacity/cargo/route/delivery IDs. Load from a reservation by moving quantity between containers. Deliver once to target store or escrow.
checks: Source 5/load 3/deliver 3 totals 5 throughout; duplicate delivery totals 5; a 4-good cart rejects 5; cart destruction records exact cargo loss.

phase: P03 — Board, construction and physical cargo
title: Implement routes, permissions and turn movement
work: Use constructed roads and explicit access permissions; move all carts one edge per turn, never from real-time animation. Revalidate catastrophe-blocked current/destination nodes and route changes.
checks: Three-node route takes two turns; blocked middle prevents crossing; seconds alone move zero edges; newly assigned cart gets no retroactive movement.

phase: P03 — Board, construction and physical cargo
title: Implement transport assignment, reroute and returned cargo
work: Assign idle carts deterministically to construction shortages, partial loads and returns. Implement destination/source/nearest-own/park fallback while keeping cargo at actual node.
checks: Two carts fulfil split loads without duplicate stock; destroyed destination triggers return/reroute; disconnected network parks goods; no route failure silently deletes cargo.

phase: P03 — Board, construction and physical cargo
title: Implement real construction bootstrap and replacement carts
work: Commit starting core package/facilities, two carts and one legal road once per setup receipt. Add delivered replacement-cart cost and staging store support. A cross-terrain infeasible site must not invent a recipe.
checks: Reloaded setup grants nothing again; destroyed cart replaced with new ID only after 1 timber/1 brick/1 ore payment; staging cache grants no VP or ownership.

phase: P03 — Board, construction and physical cargo
title: Implement centre, warehouse and road destruction consequences
work: Remove centre ownership without capture; strand surviving industry, displace workers and revalidate orders/cargo. Warehouse losses and road-route breakage are conserved. Wire last-centre dissolution event for later era safeguards.
checks: Attacker gains no automatic node; surviving cart retains cargo; destroyed warehouse loses only local goods; worker survives displaced; repeated destruction applies no second loss.

phase: P03 — Board, construction and physical cargo
title: Integrate construction and cargo turn stages
work: Connect roll→all-cart movement/delivery→ordered construction completions through normal WorldSim. Use scripted legal faction candidates until heuristic phase, with no bypass of costs.
checks: FX-CARGO completes a real delivered settlement; blocked route prevents it; immediate winner interrupt cancels later turn handlers; replay/save preserves in-transit cargo.

phase: P04 — Technology, diplomacy and heuristic factions
title: Define technology cards and prerequisite graph
work: Create six baseline cards per MVP era and exact predecessor pair map/caps/scopes. Validate cycles/references and baseline capability reachability.
checks: Prehistoric has no prerequisite; Historic activates with either named predecessor; cycle and missing predecessor fail; baseline buildings remain usable without a lucky draft.

phase: P04 — Technology, diplomacy and heuristic factions
title: Implement research archive and scoped modifiers
work: Store acquired card instances, active stacks and inactive copies. Activate eligible archives once; cap repeatable effects and preserve research history for later fission.
checks: Unplayable pick remains owned/inactive; gaining either predecessor activates once; fourth capped copy adds no effect; duplicate projection refresh grants no bonus.

phase: P04 — Technology, diplomacy and heuristic factions
title: Implement simultaneous seven-round draft
work: Deal 7 with replacement, select 1 per completed round from common snapshot, pass remainder clockwise and redeal after pick 7. Handle singleton/self-pass and era discard.
checks: After round 1 each hand 6 and each faction owns 1 new card; after round 7 each fresh hand 7; singleton works; interrupted old round drafts zero cards.

phase: P04 — Technology, diplomacy and heuristic factions
title: Implement legal observations and candidate generation
work: Build versioned faction observation and bounded legal candidate lists for construction, trade/diplomacy, technology and later military/treatment. Candidates encode real delivered costs and public/observed knowledge.
checks: Hidden wizard/private enemy fields excluded; every returned candidate passes validator; no-op exists when stuck; stale candidate cannot partially mutate.

phase: P04 — Technology, diplomacy and heuristic factions
title: Implement deterministic heuristic leadership
work: Implement C12 priority/score/tie rules and one construction/one proposal allowance. Persist policy commitments and actual selections. Use legal future-capability absence instead of pretending warfare exists yet.
checks: No repeated free-action loop; tie sorted by action ID; unaffordable road order schedules cargo; replay uses recorded selection even if model implementation changes.

phase: P04 — Technology, diplomacy and heuristic factions
title: Implement diplomacy and transit agreements
work: Implement neutral/trade-permitted defaults, proposals, alliance acceptance, war/embargo and typed commitments. Route permission reads the same relation state.
checks: Attack establishes war; embargo blocks unsettled route; accepted alliance permits transit; duplicate proposal outcome has one relationship/history effect.

phase: P04 — Technology, diplomacy and heuristic factions
title: Implement bilateral trade and escrow
work: Reserve both accepted legs atomically, create physical shipments, escrow arrivals and settle once both complete. Add fixed delivery deadline and dispute/default return paths.
checks: One delivered leg is not spendable; both legs settle once; destroyed leg produces loss/dispute without invented repayment; interrupted trade leaves goods at real locations.

phase: P04 — Technology, diplomacy and heuristic factions
title: Integrate active faction choices and round completion
work: Connect heuristic actions, trade/diplomacy, delivered completion and simultaneous draft into normal turn pipeline. Maintain single-seat and immediate-outcome constraints.
checks: Six configured seats each activate once; all factions receive matching production; only active faction initiates actions; 10-VP interrupt suppresses pending old-era draft.

phase: P04 — Technology, diplomacy and heuristic factions
title: Prove autonomous expansion without injected stock
work: Run deterministic legal roll sequences and seeded headless episodes with real Catan logistics. Diagnose any inability to reach 10 by inspecting legal candidates/board/supply; fix implementation errors without hidden gifts.
checks: At least one validated normal-rule episode reaches 10; costs and cargo conserve; saved trace replays. Report unresolved stochastic pacing separately from a rules failure.

phase: P04 — Technology, diplomacy and heuristic factions
title: Prepare faction and cargo playtest gate
work: Provide development stock/cart/decision diagnostics and player-visible cargo labels. Prepare G02 build/fixture with trade, blockage, expansion and one full draft round. Stop for Joe.
checks: FX-CARGO and faction scenario pass; inspector labels actual fields and stays out of release UI; gate packet includes exact steps and no manual PASS invented.

phase: P05 — Real-time industrial economy
title: Normalize resource and recipe catalogues
work: Import provided reference resources/recipes with recorded aliases, preserve unique building/output labels and separate Catan IDs. Compile MVP16-per-era subset while retaining full 60-per-era culture access metadata.
checks: All 48 raw definitions map correctly; every full era has 60 unique pairs/buildings/outputs and raw frequency 10; no same-terrain pair; no workbook role becomes a new sink.

phase: P05 — Real-time industrial economy
title: Implement shared finite layers and primary channels
work: Create 600-unit finite layers by hex/cycle/era, both channels per primary and best-pip node capacity. Apply city, source tech, damage and catastrophe without worker navigation.
checks: Adjacent token 6+8 still caps 5; city remains 5 slots with double flow; two nodes share one layer; new cycle does not refill old balance; services have no cargo stock.

phase: P05 — Real-time industrial economy
title: Implement installed route selection and constraint construction
work: Bind each processor input to valid exact primary channel, same-era different-terrain recipe; select one installed compatible route per factory. Build channel/processor/factory/shared-deposit constraints and explicit bottleneck reasons.
checks: Missing processor cannot produce; duplicate factories share processor constraint; exhausted source disables only affected routes; illegal same-terrain and cross-era binding fail.

phase: P05 — Real-time industrial economy
title: Implement deterministic progressive-fill allocation
work: Implement pure weighted max-min solver with exact rational carry and stable IDs. Respect all resource coefficients and global finite limits. Keep hypothetical theoretical-capacity mode read-only.
checks: Shared 0.1 processor with costs 2/3/5 gives 0.01 units/s each; 25%-health gives 0.0025 each; permutation invariance; last 0.01 finite unit is never overconsumed.

phase: P05 — Real-time industrial economy
title: Implement factory meters and individual unit creation
work: Apply allocations/finite debits/meters atomically per 100 ms tick. Add MilitaryService.spawn foundation: one stable unit per complete meter, retain fractional remainder and home/faction/era.
checks: After 60 s shared-route meters 0.6 each/no units; after 100 s exactly 3 IDs/meters 0/deposit 590; save at 59.9 s and resume gives identical completions.

phase: P05 — Real-time industrial economy
title: Integrate global Game-Time industry
work: Advance every occupied node from fixed clock quanta, queue rate/shortage/spawn events and preserve old-layer support. Apply damage/destruction before subsequent production boundary.
checks: Visited and unvisited copies produce identically; render frame changes do not alter output; duel/menu pauses prevent output; destroyed factory cannot finish a later tick.

phase: P05 — Real-time industrial economy
title: Connect real workers to illustrative production activity
work: Backfill vacant jobs with persistent new people, project active route/bottleneck into work/idle/carry animations. Visual routing failure picks safe idle cue and emits layout diagnostic only.
checks: Blocking worker path changes no meter/deposit; explicit strike modifier does; worker relocation persists and replacement gets new ID; unloaded village retains all people.

phase: P05 — Real-time industrial economy
title: Implement paid industrial repair and route expansion
work: Allow legal delivered repairs/additional processors and choose useful alternate installed routes. No player management menu. Ensure price, health restoration and capacity recomputation occur once.
checks: Damaged processor returns to full rate after real repair payment; adding useful route consumes cost; unsupported imported industrial input remains unavailable.

phase: P05 — Real-time industrial economy
title: Build causal industry and depletion regression scenarios
work: Exercise depleted finite source, shared last-unit allocation, catastrophe suppression, explicit strike, route fallback and actual building destruction through normal commands. Include carry values in failure bundles.
checks: Every output change has a real limiting cause; total finite extraction conserved; animation-only change has no output effect; continuing legacy layer retains exact balance.

phase: P05 — Real-time industrial economy
title: Prepare economy readability playtest gate
work: Expose development allocation/constraint/finite diagnostics and knowledge-filtered street feedback. Prepare G03 village where Joe can identify a bottleneck and observe persistent workers/output. Stop for human review.
checks: FX-INDUSTRY numerical oracles pass; displayed work matches actual selected route; player can test path blocking without economic effect; gate remains pending until accepted.

phase: P06 — Military and world magic
title: Complete individual unit, formation and buff state
work: Extend spawn foundation with saved unit health, cooldown, position, home, shields and timed buffs. Formations group unit IDs and derive strength; no aggregate replacement.
checks: Each manufactured soldier has one ID; no unit belongs to two groups; health/buff/shield balances roundtrip; era multiplier applied exactly once.

phase: P06 — Military and world magic
title: Implement shared combat math and targeting oracles
work: Implement era-adjusted hit damage, cover, armour, range eligibility and deterministic target ordering. Share golden cases between Python/Godot and gather simultaneous damage before casualties.
checks: Attack 15/cover 0.25 yields 11 Prehistoric and 113 Historic; equal targets break by health then ID; same-step lethal opponents can both hit; next step dead actor cannot attack.

phase: P06 — Military and world magic
title: Implement strategic formation movement and withdrawal
work: Move active-faction disengaged units up to 2 edges, stop on first hostility and preserve order/turn receipt. Add withdrawal intent and later legal retreat, without an immediate extra move.
checks: Seconds alone move zero nodes; inactive faction stays; hostile first edge stops second; new unit gets no past move; blocked retreat revalidates/re-engages.

phase: P06 — Military and world magic
title: Implement bounded off-screen battle resolution
work: Resolve actual individual snapshot in 250 ms steps, frozen handoff buffs and no global time/industry. Support target approach, casualties, structures, withdrawal, unreachable/120 s stalemate.
checks: 120 s timeout is not victory; no production/reinforcements accrue; identity/health/losses conserve; stalemate is not recalculated continuously without a material event.

phase: P06 — Military and world magic
title: Implement Godot local tactical encounter
work: Use exclusive lease and 50 ms steps for real positions/navigation/LOS/range/cooldowns/cover. Each sprite binds one persistent unit. Return checkpoints/casualties/building damage.
checks: Blocked military path changes actual attack opportunity; worker navigation remains separate; local fight emits valid ordered deltas; leased units are not also resolved off-screen.

phase: P06 — Military and world magic
title: Implement arrival, departure and reinforcement handoff
work: Close outgoing battle at acknowledged checkpoint before Python resolution; retain lease on Wait. Add versioned new-unit handshake after factory completion. Freeze leases on immediate world interrupts.
checks: Leaving after half an army dies never restores casualties; duplicate reinforcement adds one unit; stale checkpoint cannot overwrite result; Wait does not close the battle.

phase: P06 — Military and world magic
title: Implement unrestricted local destruction magic
work: Validate local observation and ordinary-unit/building target kind, independent of allegiance. Route leased targets through encounter owner. Destroy workers/carts/buildings with canonical job/cargo/ownership consequences.
checks: Friendly/neutral/enemy targets all work; remote/group/self/rival-duel actors reject appropriately; repeated target causes no duplicate loss; wizard has no faction-combat damage path.

phase: P06 — Military and world magic
title: Implement stacking support buffs and pause-safe expiry
work: Apply shield 25%HP, frequency 25%, range 1 with distinct 30 s Game-Time effect IDs and caps. Consume earliest-expiry shield, preserve canonical HP and save balances.
checks: Shield caps at 2 xHP; frequency 3 x; range+4; expiry removes unused shield only; a 60 s duel expires nothing; duplicate cast receipt grants no second stack.

phase: P06 — Military and world magic
title: Connect military objectives and turn battles
work: Add defend/assemble/attack/hold candidates using observed strength and commitment rules. Integrate movement, off-screen fights, local lease opening and real destruction into normal turn stages.
checks: No unobserved enemy strength in policy features; attackers gain no automatic node ownership; local arrival battle leases correct units; active-only movement and immediate interruption remain true.

phase: P06 — Military and world magic

work: Build FX-BATTLE with ranged/melee/cover, actual factories and buildings. Compare continuation/conservation through enter/leave/save/reconnect; exact offscreen-versus-local casualty equality is not required.
checks: All participant IDs accounted for as alive/dead; cargo/factory destruction has real effects; source old-era units remain weaker; wizard intervention works without army orders.

phase: P07 — Catastrophe and distributed pressure
title: Implement typed cubes, deck and seeded initial pressure
work: Create stable typed cubes/causes, seeded deck/discard and 3 distinct starting placements respecting start viability. Add persisted era cadence/draw count/placement ordinal.

phase: P07 — Catastrophe and distributed pressure

work: Fourth attempt increments outbreak, propagates incoming type in stable adjacency order and tracks event visited set. Threshold 8 commits terminal once and stops remaining work.
checks: Cyclic saturated triangle outbreaks each hex at most once; count 7→8 stops neighbour mutations immediately; repeated terminal command emits no second Game Over.

phase: P07 — Catastrophe and distributed pressure

checks: One cube stops affected source but leaves finite balance unchanged; cart cannot cross touching node; wizard/army can enter; unrelated hex output continues.

phase: P07 — Catastrophe and distributed pressure

phase: P07 — Catastrophe and distributed pressure

work: Add eligibility, adjacency and one-cube treatment. Reserve active responding formation action before movement. Demon responder first; declare full-era capability extension.

phase: P07 — Catastrophe and distributed pressure
title: Integrate catastrophe manifestation entry with duel lease
work: Prepare normal duel entry for an eligible specific cube with global pause/visit preconditions. Adapt retained duel core or implement chosen fallback baseline now; later adventure tasks add richer puzzle/recovery/content.

phase: P07 — Catastrophe and distributed pressure
title: Build pressure, ordinary failure and terminal scenarios
work: Run FX-HAZARD through source shutdown, treatment, turn cadence, saved visits and a terminal cascade. Make ordinary duel non-victory nonterminal and keep military immunity.
checks: No Game Over on ordinary loss or faction asset destruction; terminal returns menu once; saved treatment ledger intact; pollution placeholder definition cannot enter a duel.

phase: P07 — Catastrophe and distributed pressure
title: Prepare battle and catastrophe playtest gate
work: Prepare G04 build with autonomous local battle, unrestricted spells, buffs, three-hex treatment scenario and escalating warnings. Provide short exact steps and known off-screen approximation. Stop for Joe.

title: Complete person goals, relationships and knowledge profiles
work: Extend existing IDs with typed preferences/goals, dialogue profile, relationships and known facts. Add leader/anchor/worker/displaced states without replacing records.
checks: Role promotion preserves relationships/history; dead person remains tombstone; each production job has one living anchor or explicit vacancy; save preserves all profile refs.

title: Produce Windows sidecar and Godot release bundle

checks: Windows executable actually produced on compatible runner; no Python/server setup needed; no runtime download/APIkey; missing platform capability reported as blocker, not fabricated export.

phase: P16 — Release hardening and completion
title: Run clean-machine offline installation tests
work: Test packaged Windows app without developer dependencies, internet disconnected, loopback available, path withspaces/nonASCII/read-only install. Verify start, save/load, move folder, crash recovery, quit/child cleanup.
checks: Recorded actual Windows evidence; saves use user-data path; no orphan sidecar; moved bundle works; all required assets/models local. Linux-only evidence cannot pass Windows gate.

phase: P16 — Release hardening and completion
title: Run release scenario and multi-cycle regression suite
work: Run full required suite and 3 complete full-cycle continuations using release manifests. Include FX-RECOVERY and content branch matrix, not just import/parse. Record unexecuted/skipped tests as failures.
checks: All required tests actually run; exact release hashes/commit match reports; no different debug definitions or hidden injected outcomes satisfy normal-play scenario.

phase: P16 — Release hardening and completion
title: Write player guide, known limits and release evidence index
work: Explain controls, save/recovery, offline startup and core clocks without implementation details in player flows. Record actual supportedplatform, remaining optional extensions and evidence links.
checks: Guide matches release build; no promise of mobile/Utopia/fullvoice; all material known defects stated; neural/content/art verification points to actual artifacts.

phase: P16 — Release hardening and completion
title: Assemble final manual acceptance candidate
work: Freeze candidate commit/manifest/checksums, package, seed saves, automated summary and concise known defects. G10 steps cover normal launch, full baseline play and long-term continuity. Do not publish externally.
checks: Candidate bytes match evidence; no pending required task/gate concealed; executable available for Joe with no developer setup; final acceptance remains AWAITING_HUMAN.

phase: P16 — Release hardening and completion
title: Complete final playtest gate and close the build ledger
work: Present candidate to Joe and stop for G10. After an explicit PASS, record exact accepted build and finish ledger. If fixes requested, reopen relevant tasks, create regression evidence and resubmit; do not silently update accepted bytes.
checks: Full baseline marked complete only after all automated gates, 3 qualified policies, content floors and explicit G10 PASS. Publishing/distribution outside local deliverables remains a separate user instruction.
